LanguageData.MM_StatusTip: Recharges automatically from the light network. Stores up to 6000 light.\nPiloted idle: 1 light/s; moving: 3 light/s; missile: 30 light; caravan travel: 1200 light/day.\nRestores 25 shield points for 250 light.
LanguageData.MM_BoardDesc: Choose a colonist to walk to the warframe and enter the cockpit.
LanguageData.MM_EjectDesc: Let the pilot out beside the warframe and stop movement and firing.
LanguageData.MM_MoveDesc: Move to a location. You can also right-click the ground with the warframe selected.
LanguageData.MM_AttackDesc: Fire two missiles 0.2 seconds apart, then recover for 1 second. Each deals 10 damage with 100% armor penetration in a cross extending 1 cell from the center in each cardinal direction (5 cells total) and can hit allies. Costs 60 light per pair. Range: 26 cells; minimum: 2.5.
LanguageData.MM_AutoFireDesc: Automatically attack visible enemies in range while powered and either piloted or operating autonomously.
LanguageData.MM_StopDesc: Cancel movement and the current manual attack target.
LanguageData.MM_TeleportDesc: Teleport with the pilot and all cargo to clear ground covered by the light network on the same map. Uses 300 network traffic. Cooldown: about 16.7 seconds.
LanguageData.MM_LoadDesc: Choose cargo, then a colonist to load it. Capacity: 500 kg.
LanguageData.MM_UnloadDesc: Unload all cargo beside the warframe.
LanguageData.MM_NeedsPilotLight: Requires light and either an able pilot or drafted autonomous operation.
LanguageData.MM_WorldSpeed: Warframe travel speed: {0} world tiles/day, unaffected by roads, terrain or night rest. Mixed caravans use the slowest warframe's base speed, then apply the riding multiplier.
